stress_title: On easy maps the planners separate only when the sensor or pose gets worse (Quick on random_0: 17 of 18 planners reached B 5/5). Stress: 5 seeds, same map; variations = your drone's sensor (truth pose), crazyflie (4 beams, truth pose) and your drone's sensor with a VIO fault (the one chosen below, else VIO jump 0.5 m). Then run.
count_msg: 270 runs = 18 planners x 3 variations (ideal / truth pose; ideal / VIO jump; crazyflie / truth pose) x 5 seeds. Estimate: about 2 min 33 s on 4 workers (from run times measured in this browser). Run time limit: 60 s of sim time (Auto: random family, default).Quick separates 5/5 from 0/5; telling 5/5 from 4/5 needs about 33 seeds (95 % Wilson: 5/5 57 %-100 %, 0/5 0 %-43 %).

stress.headline: 17 planners tie at the top; run Thorough or more seeds to separate them (n=15 per planner, best 12/15 reached B, 95 % CI 55 %-93 %).

quick.headline: 17 planners tie at the top; run Thorough or more seeds to separate them (n=5 per planner, best 5/5 reached B, 95 % CI 57 %-100 %).

pooled.text: Pareto-optimal (all variations pooled): Lazy Theta*, unknown map (geofenced) 17.69 s, 0.506 m, 80 %; D* Lite, unknown map (geofenced) 20.25 s, 0.516 m, 80 %; Theta* (any-angle), known map 17.08 s, 0.334 m, 67 %. Best success group: 17 planners whose 95 % interval overlaps Lazy Theta*, unknown map (geofenced)'s (55 %-93 %).

ideal|truth.text: Pareto-optimal (ideal / truth pose): Theta* (any-angle), known map 17.08 s, 0.870 m, 100 %. Best success group: 17 planners whose 95 % interval overlaps Theta* (any-angle), known map's (57 %-100 %).

ideal|jump.text: Pareto-optimal (ideal / VIO jump): Lazy Theta*, unknown map (geofenced) 17.63 s, 0.820 m, 40 %. Best success group: 18 planners whose 95 % interval overlaps Lazy Theta*, unknown map (geofenced)'s (12 %-77 %); no time to B, not ranked: APF + wall follow, A* + ESDF, known map, Bug2, DWA + 3 s scan memory, freest beam (reactive), Informed RRT* 5000, known map, Lazy Theta*, known map, straight line to B, TangentBug, Theta* (any-angle), known map, VFH+.

crazyflie|truth.text: Pareto-optimal (crazyflie / truth pose): Theta* (any-angle), known map 17.08 s, 0.870 m, 100 %. Best success group: 16 planners whose 95 % interval overlaps Theta* (any-angle), known map's (57 %-100 %).
